claims.text: The paragraph-level neural network model achieves the best performance for predicting both implicit and explicit discourse relations simultaneously.
The model shows improved performance on contingency relations, indicating it works well for this specific type of discourse relation.
The model achieves significant improvements in recognizing minority discourse relations like Comparison and Temporal, suggesting it works better for these than for others.
Explicit discourse relations have achieved F1 scores greater than 90%, indicating the model performs well for explicit relations.
